WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    o.recordvault,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as order_avg
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.recordvault
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_avg) as overall_avg_value
  FROM order_averages
),
kept_orders AS (
  SELECT oa.recordvault, oa.order_avg
  FROM order_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg ov
  WHERE oa.order_avg > ov.overall_avg_value
),
kept_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_avg) as kept_avg_value
  FROM kept_orders
)
SELECT 
  ko.recordvault,
  ko.order_avg,
  ko.order_avg - ov.overall_avg_value as diff_from_overall,
  ko.order_avg - ka.kept_avg_value as diff_from_kept
FROM kept_orders ko
CROSS JOIN overall_avg ov
CROSS JOIN kept_avg_calc ka
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN (ko.order_avg - ka.kept_avg_value) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  (ko.order_avg - ka.kept_avg_value) DESC
LIMIT 10
